chunks: 5 – Al-Ḥusayn ibn Mihrān ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, Abū  al-Ḥusayn. Wāqifī. Weak. He has a book about (or from) Mūsā.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ: Al-Husayn ibn Mihran, the narrator's name
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak, indicating the narrator's reliability status
key_terms.كِتَابٌ: Book, referring to a written work or collection
key_terms.وَاقِفٌ: Wāqifī, a follower of Waqif ibn Ibrahim

ai.seo_question: Who is Al-Husayn ibn Miran and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the Kitab al-Du'afa describing the narrator Al--Husayn ibn Mihran. It identifies his lineage, his kunya, his status as a Wāqifī (follower of Waqif ibn Ibrahim), and notes that he is considered weak in hadith transmission, while also mentioning he authored a book attributed to Musa.
